preserved_interrupted_release.limitation: Retains timeout failures only; system-sleep causation is assessed separately.

limitations: Retained engineering evidence does not establish literary quality, first-tier ranking, production deployment or GitHub CI.
Some browser suites retain one source snapshot or no child hashes; the complete release before/after/current source guard covers them and each guard type is recorded.
The runner does not retain actual child argv; ordered check names, source inventory, exit results, local logs and exact sanitized tails are cross-checked.
PNG bytes, dimensions, original/public equality and current-suite modification times are checked; visual inspection is recorded separately.
Public JSON is scanned for private absolute paths and known credential patterns. No credential files or production database were read.
Existing paid/external counters are checked when present; loopback-only setup for new chat tests is also matched against reviewed source. This checker does not capture network traffic.
